steps.name: Epilogue ~ Iris' Adventurer
steps.objective: Watch the story of those who have come to see [Iris] in 「Frozen World」.

lines.text: (In a space filled with ice, two beings have fought for a long time, with no end in sight.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: When will you give up?

lines.speaker: 이블오더
lines.text: I'll keep going until you're destroyed!

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Then I have no choice. I'll face you until then.

lines.speaker: 이블오더
lines.text: Good. Then... Wait, this power...

lines.speaker: 이블오더
lines.text: Why are spirits swarming here? That's Harmonia and Geis. What are they doing here?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Spirit Kings, what brings you here?

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: Heart of Iris, you no longer need to fight in this place.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Exactly as Geis said, Iris.

lines.speaker: 이블오더
lines.text: Mere Spirit Kings dare interfere with my battle? I am about to claim a god's body!
(Evil Order advances, irritated by the intruders.)

lines.speaker: 이블오더
lines.text: I can't move...?!

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Lady Gaia?

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: You were created by a being that torments Iris and throws this world into chaos. Now, disappear.

lines.speaker: 이블오더
lines.text: What are you? W-wait... You're...

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Harmonia, Geis.
(At Harmonia and Geis's gestures, the spirits fly forward and seize Evil Order.)

lines.speaker: 이블오더
lines.text: Kyaa! What can paltry Spirit Kings do to one who is all but an avatar of their master? Ridiculous.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: A true master would never act as you do.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: One who sows discord in the world is no master of ours.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Iris, don't be afraid. Girl reborn as a god through Seres's fate... Now, act for your adventurer's sake.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Lady Gaia...
(Gaia nods.)

lines.speaker: 이블오더
lines.text: I will swallow this world and become its god. Do not defy me. You must keep fighting me. You cannot kill...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: You and I are both parts of Iris's heart. I know neither of us can truly disappear within it.

lines.speaker: 이블오더
lines.text: That's right. You understand perfectly. Heh heh...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: People hold many feelings in their hearts. Iris is no different. You are her darker feelings, mingled with fear, and you want them to keep growing.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: But Iris is finding peace, little by little. Everyone who wishes for her other feelings to grow stronger than you is helping her.

lines.speaker: 이블오더
lines.text: What are you trying to say?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I hadn't realized it. All along, everyone was here with me...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: ...Sleep now. This is for everyone's sake...

lines.speaker: 이블오더
lines.text: What? If you had gained power, I would have known...
(Iris reaches toward the immobilized Evil Order. The spirits begin wrapping around Evil Order's body and face.)

lines.speaker: 이블오더
lines.text: I won't retreat like this! I will become this world's god... Its god...
(Time passes, and the spirits surrounding Evil Order disperse. Only Evil Order's frozen form remains.)

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: We'll take our leave now.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: We'll be going.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Thank you, Harmonia, Geis.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: But where is Gaia? Lady Gaia! Lady Gaia!

lines.speaker: 가이아의 목소리
lines.text: [Iris... Iris...]

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Lady Gaia, where are you?

lines.speaker: 가이아의 목소리
lines.text: [Where I am doesn't matter now. Iris, I have a favor to ask. Stay beside the adventurer. Let them become your adventurer, no one else's. Not even mine...]
(Gaia's voice fades, and tears gather in Iris's eyes. A vivid, beautiful rainbow rises over the frozen world's sky.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Lady Gaia...
